# Background {.unnumbered}

Confoederatio, Research Division (CRD) working papers are typeset in the **Intellte** single-column layout using **Jost\*** for headers and subtitles, **Karla** for the division banner, author/date metadata, figure typography, and table headers, and **Source Serif 4** (`10pt` on `15pt` leading) for left-aligned body prose [@belkin2002using; @berard1994embedding].^[Footnotes are collected as numbered endnotes at the end of the paper beneath the `Footnotes` section heading.]
